summary: Two-channel support is in the library, the measuring tool, the rules and the build; the six engines and the three loops thruster_burn_loop, ground_scrape_loop and dust_patter_loop are now mid/side files whose mono sum is the old mono sound (difference -62.6 dB or lower against assets/audio/cache/round1). One full build with CLAP ran: 58 of 64 registered sounds pass; the 6 ERRORs are the other agent's drive and weapon loops that still return mono while sounds.json says 2 channels. Table (new files; corr = left/right over the file, corrLow = below 150 Hz, LR = level difference, mono-diff = mono sum minus old mono file relative to the old file): engine_main_t000 corr 0.835 corrLow 0.999 LR 0.04 dB mono-diff -62.6 dB; t025 0.762 / 0.990 / 0.15 / -68.9; t050 0.682 / 0.988 / 0.08 / -73.8; t075 0.597 / 0.989 / 0.14 / -77.7; t100 0.510 / 0.988 / 0.04 / -80.7; boost 0.370 / 0.985 / 0.03 / -83.7; thruster_burn_loop 0.600 / 0.996 / 0.03 / -70.6; ground_scrape_loop 0.636 / 1.000 / 0.07 / -72.7; dust_patter_loop 0.654 / 0.999 / 0.36 / -66.5. All nine pass every rule.
changed: tools/audio/synth/room.py: mid_side(mid, side, periodic, ratio) and SIDE_LOW_HZ/SIDE_CORNER_HZ (side high-pass corner 170 Hz, order 12 circular or order 8 causal; left = mid + side, right = mid - side); exported from synth/__init__.py together with is_mid_side(spec)
tools/audio/synth/levels.py: set_level(..., mono_sum=False); in loudness mode a two-channel sound is measured as (L+R)/2 so the approved mono level is kept and the side only adds width
tools/audio/synth/registry.py: is_mid_side(spec) (channels 2 on path structure or energy, not ir); render() sets the level on the mono sum for those. Interfaces of register/Ctx/render unchanged

tools/audio/synth/wavio.py: to_int16/write_wav(shared_dither=False); the build passes True for mid/side files so the mono sum carries the old mono file's dither (without it idle would sit near -59 dB from dither alone)

tools/audio/listen/measure.py: stereo_stats (corr, corrLow with a sharp split at 150 Hz, levelDiffDb, monoRmsDb) and peak_share (power within +-2 Welch bins of the strongest bin over the total); analyse() for two channels measures shares, centroid, peaks, fundamental and peakShare on the mono sum, adds stereo, lufsMono, peakShare, peakShareHz; text output prints them

tools/audio/synth/rules.py: energy path rules (energy-high-share 30 % above 1 kHz, energy-air-share 8 % above 4 kHz, energy-weight 10 % below 250 Hz, energy-peak 15 %) and two-channel rules for structure and energy (stereo-correlation 0.3 to 0.9, stereo-bass-correlation above 0.98, stereo-level-diff below 1.5 dB); path rules use the mono sum; cabin two-channel sounds and cabin_ir are exempt

tools/audio/build.py: manifest fields hash (12 hex of SHA-256), place and cue from sounds.json, channels from sounds.json; hash is REQUIRED in the contract check but assemble_manifest fills hash/place/cue into per-sound JSONs written by older builds so partial rebuilds stay valid; checks gain peakShare, stereo, lufsMono; mid/side files written with shared dither

tools/audio/synth/cat_engines.py: render_engine(n, t, seed_family) (default family unchanged, so the mid is bit-identical to before), side from family engine_main_side, side_ratio(t) = 0.30 + 0.27*min(t,1.4) (0.30 idle to 0.68 boost), render_engine_stereo
tools/audio/synth/cat_thrusters.py: render_burn(n, family) split out, side from thruster_burn_side at ratio 0.5

tools/audio/synth/cat_landing.py: scrape and dust refactored into helpers with the mid unchanged; the side is the same grinding/gravel from other seeds (scrape) plus the very same stones (scrape, 26) and grains/pebbles (dust, 2400+18) at the same times weighted by a per-event position in [-0.8, 0.8] resp. [-0.9, 0.9] from their own seed; settle_creak, gear and touchdowns untouched
tools/audio/synth/README.md: heading Two channels, manifest fields, engine note, level note

tools/audio/synth/tests/test_synth.py: 17 new tests (mid_side, stats, analyse on the mono sum, shared dither, level on the mono sum, is_mid_side, stereo rules, energy rules, manifest hash/place/channels, assembling old JSON)
assets/audio/cache/round1: copies of the old mono engine files, thruster_burn_loop, ground_scrape_loop, dust_patter_loop (cp -n; existing files kept)
Rendered into assets/audio/render by the full build (also assets/audio/cache/render-wip-stereo from the first tries and assets/audio/cache/stereo-lib-build.log)
verified: tests: 38 tests in tools/audio/synth/tests pass and 22 in tools/audio/listen/tests pass (ran in this session, after the last code change)
full build with CLAP, no --describe: 64 rendered, 58 pass, 6 ERROR (listed under openIssues), manifest of 114 sounds validates against the contract (log: assets/audio/cache/stereo-lib-build.log)
all nine of my new two-channel files pass every rule, including the new ones, as measured from the written 16-bit files

mono sum of the new files against the old mono files (round1 copies), RMS of the difference relative to the old file: idle -62.6 dB, then -68.9, -73.8, -77.7, -80.7, boost -83.7; thruster_burn_loop -70.6; ground_scrape_loop -72.7; dust_patter_loop -66.5; all below -60 dB. Idle is the floor set by 16-bit rounding of a quiet file, not by a change of sound

side channel numbers computed from the files: nothing below 150 Hz to speak of (0.2 % to 3 % of the side's energy below 150 Hz; engines 0.2 % at idle, 1 to 3 % above), >99 % of the side's energy in 150 Hz to 1 kHz for engines and burn; side-to-mid power: idle -10.5 dB, t025 -8.7, t050 -7.2, t075 -6.0, t100 -4.9, boost -3.4 (steps of 1.1 to 1.8 dB, monotonic, so the crossfade between levels grows evenly); burn -6.0, scrape -6.5, dust -6.8 dB

spectrogram pictures opened: engine_main_t000.png (steady band from about 60 Hz to 1 kHz, strongest around 100 to 250 Hz, nothing above 1 kHz, no lines or pulses) and engine_main_boost.png (same band much louder, denser; seven separate rattle groups between 1 and 6 kHz, sparse, quiet, as before) look like the old mono sounds, as the numbers say they must; dust_patter_loop.png (broadband low band with ten short rattle groups at 1 to 5 kHz, no steady lines). The pictures are mono mixes, so they show the approved sound and say nothing about the width
determinism: the determinism test renders twice and compares bytes; the mid is generated by the unchanged code path with the unchanged seed names (the numbers above confirm the mono sum)

levels: loudness of the mono sum equals the table values (checks.lufsMono -38, -32, -27, -23, -20, -17 for the engines, -30, -28, -34 for burn, scrape, dust); the stereo LUFS of the file is 3.4 to 4.8 dB higher; no file was limited by the ceiling (true peak at most -2.9 dBFS)

state of the other agent's sounds at the time of the build: impact_shield_light/medium/heavy (energy, 2 channels) pass all rules incl. the new energy ones; hull impacts, hull_stress_groan, debris_patter, all six alarms, cruise_charge, cruise_engage, cruise_disengage, fold_charge pass
notVerified: nothing was listened to: width, evenness of the crossfade and the placement of single stones and grains are judged only from correlation, level and band numbers; whether the idle (correlation 0.835) is wide enough or the boost (0.37) too wide is a matter for the owner's ears
that the owner still hears the approved idle as the approved idle: the mono sum is the same to -62 dB, but headphones play left and right, which now carry the side as well
the describing model (--describe) was not run, so there are no 'described' answers for the new files

CLAP for the three landing/thruster loops stays below the hint threshold (thruster_burn_loop -0.073, ground_scrape_loop -0.035, dust_patter_loop -0.139), same as the old mono files were judged; engines are all positive (+0.005 idle to +0.202); I did not change that
the audition page (port 5190) was not opened; whether it plays two channels, uses hash, place and cue, or shows the new checks fields (stereo, peakShare, lufsMono) was not tested
SOUND_DESIGN.md section 3 does not list the extra checks fields (stereo, lufsMono, peakShare); not my file, so not changed
openIssues: ERROR in the build because the renderers still return mono while sounds.json says channels 2: cruise_loop, fold_jump, fold_tunnel_loop, fold_exit (cat_drive.py), weapon_beam_loop, mining_laser_loop (weapons, cat_drive.py or cat_weapons). The other agent is on these; use mid_side(mid, side, periodic, ratio) and, for one-shots (fold_jump, fold_exit), periodic=False. Their old JSON and WAV (mono) are still in assets/audio/render, so the manifest lists them as before

level setting changed for every two-channel sound of the structure and energy path: loudness is set on the mono sum (set_level mono_sum=True via is_mid_side), peak targets still look at the louder channel. So cruise_loop (-24 LUFS), fold_tunnel_loop (-34) and the two weapon loops will keep their old level when ported; the stereo file itself measures a few dB louder

the correlation window 0.3 to 0.9 limits how little the idle can differ (side ratio at least about 0.23 for corr below 0.9) and how wide the boost can go (about 0.73); chosen 0.30 and 0.68. If the owner wants a clearer idle width the rule must move

peakShare of the mono sum is 0.35 to 0.42 for the engines from t025 up (pump and plasma tones in the approved sound) and 0.25 to 0.35 for burn and scrape: not a rule for the structure path, only for energy, but a reader of the manifest will see it
mid_side side filter: for one-shots it is causal Butterworth order 8 at 170 Hz, which rings a little after the event; the energy sounds of the other agent pass the rules with it
stale stage files: assets/audio/cache/render-wip-stereo holds my intermediate renders and can be deleted
git status shows tools/audio/synth/cat_impacts.py modified by the other agent; I did not touch it
